notes.title: Small update, fix the problem of displacement and value recovery too fast caused
notes.notes:
1. Fix the problem that when the player's game frame number is too high (more than 60 frames), the player will be blasted out of the map by the commander Wan when he defeats the commander wan to enter the plot, resulting in the game stuck.

2. Fix the problem that the enemy's internal power recovers very fast when the player's game frame number is too high (more than 60 frames). Now it is changed to no matter how many frames, the recovery speed is the same.

3. Fix the problem of losing fonts in some cases.

notes.title: 《末代侠客》现已发行
notes.notes:
由我个人制作的横版动作武侠游戏《末代侠客》目前已登录steam平台，售价18元人民币。
游戏共有7大关卡，其中包括8个主线BOSS和4个隐藏BOSS。
Steam的试玩版已经上线steam，可下载试玩。

游戏特色：
★手绘的像素风格：人物、动画和场景设计全部由个人手绘完成（部分场景使用免费授权素材修改，人物和动画完全原创）。
★悲壮的武侠故事：扮演侠义心肠的剑客，在凄凉的南宋末年，以救济苍生为己任，渴望在这乱世中为百姓求得一片安宁。或许这注定是一场失败的战斗，但，侠之大者，为国为民，能做到问心无愧，便能身死而无憾。
★硬核的横版动作：以进攻、闪避、格挡为核心的横版动作游戏，玩家需要在破解敌人招数的同时发动进攻，武功、暗器和药瓶可以协助玩家战胜对手
★精妙的地图设计：庞大且错综复杂的地图，隐藏着许多不为人知的秘密地区，等待玩家去探索发现。
★独特的内力系统：内力系统是游戏战斗的核心，通过消耗内力可以释放强力武学招式以及格挡敌人攻击，内力不足时很容易陷入危境
★丰富的武学招式：大量武学秘籍散落在江湖各地，等待玩家去探索获得，每一套武学秘籍都分为招式和心法，招式能够让玩家使出强力技能，而心法则能为玩家提供强力的被动属性，当同时装备招式和心法时才能激发该武学秘籍真正的力量

notes.title: First update after sales, reduce the difficulty of the early stage and fix some
notes.notes:
Game version: 1.01

Fix bugs

1. Fix the bug that will still release skills when Kuishan has no blood.

2. Fix the bug that the protagonist sometimes has no blood but is not dead.

3. Fix the bug that the time slowing effect doesn't end correctly when you trigger counterattack shield and free sword because of dodge.

4. Fix the bug that does not trigger the plot correctly when entering the final boss room.

5. Fix bugs that sometimes monsters don't die normally.

6. Fix some wall bugs caused by high frame rate (to be fixed).

optimization

1. Weaken the mountain bandit leader Kuishan, slightly reduce the stage 2 damage, and remove the arrow rain attached to the smashing attack.

2. Optimize the horse warrior AI.

3. Weaken the fan health of the four masters Li Hua, and set it to unable to repel.

4. Reduce the sound wave size of four masters Zhao Qin.

5. Lower the maximum internal power of the alliance leader.

6. Reduce the damage of the final boss.
